other_conditions: Family annual income must not exceed Rs. 72,000 per annum (general candidates)
Maximum age 40 years for general candidates and 45 years for SC/ST candidates
Should be registered in Employment Exchange for at least 5 years (general candidates) or at least 1 year (differently abled candidates)
Should not be a regular student of any school or college
Should not be in any type of employment
Physical disability required for differently abled candidates
benefits_summary: Monthly assistance ranging from Rs. 200 to Rs. 600 for general candidates based on education level, and Rs. 600 to Rs. 1,000 for differently‑abled candidates.
